issues.title: Tooltip overlays card metric
issues.description: The tooltip popover renders directly on top of the primary KPI metric text.
issues.evidence: The dark tooltip box obscures the percentage value in the middle KPI card.
issues.suggestion: Configure tooltip placement to display above or beside the trigger with adequate offset.
issues.triageNote: Eval page forces the conversion-card tooltip open via defaultOpen with side=bottom; an open tooltip placed below a label naturally covers the metric beneath it. DOM-measured geometry is correct: arrow center x=411 exactly matches trigger center x=411, gap = sideOffset(8)+arrowHeight(10)=18px, content fully in viewport. Real tooltips are transient hover overlays — no component defect.

issues.title: Misplaced anchor and content obstruction
issues.description: The tooltip obscures descriptive text and its pointer does not align with the info trigger icon.
issues.evidence: Tooltip box covers card body copy while the arrow points downward away from the top-right info icon.
issues.suggestion: Reposition tooltip relative to the info trigger or present context inline on small screens.
issues.triageNote: Both tooltips on this page are forced open via defaultOpen; the header one (side=bottom) correctly covers the body copy below it, and the two open tooltips even overlap each other by 6px — impossible in real usage. Arrow alignment is NOT defective: measured arrow center x=337/324 exactly equals trigger center x=337/324; Radix collision handling also correctly flipped the second tooltip bottom→top near the viewport bottom. The 'arrow points downward' read is the shadcn diamond's inner half inside the tooltip box. No component defect.

issues.title: Tooltip obscures price breakdown
issues.description: The active tooltip overlaps the line items directly above its trigger icon, hiding rate details.
issues.evidence: Tooltip box covers text between Price breakdown and Total line in the right sidebar.
issues.suggestion: Reposition tooltip to display above or to the side with adequate clearance.
issues.triageNote: Eval page forces the total-row tooltip open via defaultOpen with side=top, so it correctly covers the price line items above the trigger — inherent to a top-opening tooltip held open in a static screenshot. Geometry verified: arrow center x=885 = trigger center x=885, gap 16.3px ≈ sideOffset(6)+arrowHeight(10), content in viewport. Transient hover overlay in real usage — no component defect.
